title: coryphantha henricksonii
intro: Coryphantha henricksonii, commonly known as the Pediocactus henricksonii or Henrickson's ball cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, inflammation, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Coryphantha henricksonii include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which may help in pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, although further research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive compounds and their effects.
